title: PixelOS Pure Google ROM on Xiaomi Pad 5 Full Flash Guide
blurb: PixelOS on the Xiaomi Pad 5 — a pure Google experience on the tablet, plus the download links and the clean flash steps.
video_description:
PixelOS on the Xiaomi Pad 5 — a pure Google experience on the tablet, plus the download links and the clean flash steps.

PixelOS is what you flash when you want the tablet to feel like a big Pixel: stock launcher, stock icons, Google's own apps, and none of the manufacturer extras you never asked for. On a Pad 5 it suits the big screen well — the layout is simple, the settings are where you expect them, and there's far less to dig through than on HyperOS.

It's a custom ROM, so it's a clean flash. Back up first, install the driver, and keep the cable connected. The links below include a main link and an alternative mirror, so if one is slow, try the other.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi Pad 5
🧩 ROM     : PixelOS (Pure Google)
📟 Type    : Tablet

🧼 What You Get
• The stock Pixel launcher and Google apps
• A clean settings menu without the extra layers
• None of the manufacturer bloat apps
• A UI that actually suits the tablet's big screen

🛠️ What You Need
• The PixelOS ROM package for the Xiaomi Pad 5
• ADB and Fastboot driver on your PC
• Platform Tools for the commands
• A compatible recovery
• A full backup and a charged battery

📝 Steps
1. Back up your data and charge the tablet properly.
2. Install the driver and confirm fastboot detects the device.
3. Flash the recovery and any required vbmeta file.
4. Format data, then flash PixelOS.
5. Reboot to system and set it up like a fresh Pixel.

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• Skipping the data format — clean flash means clean.
• Grabbing a package built for a different Pad model.
• Assuming Google apps need a separate install when they're already in the build.
